mode: Configuration presence only; no secret values or external requests.

groups.name: Database
notes: Connection, schema drift, backups and migrations must be checked separately.

groups.name: Google sign-in
notes: Provider callback must match /api/auth/google/callback. Live browser authorization is a separate check.

groups.name: Email delivery
notes: Verify the sender domain and actual delivery; credentials alone do not prove delivery.

groups.name: Persistent file storage
notes: Confirm the configured path is shared by web and workers and persists across releases. Development-only storage is not a production guarantee.

groups.name: AI generation
notes: Model access, linked syllabus/textbook evidence, worker execution and educator review require separate checks.

groups.name: Internal Python API
notes: Verify the configured identity is an active administrator.

groups.name: Deadline worker
notes: Run a separate worker with WORKER_KINDS=EXAM_FINALIZE; inspect overdue queue age and finalization.
